slides.headline: PERPLEXITY JUST DROPPED A $200/MONTH AI WORKER ON YOUR PC
slides.subline: IT READS EVERYTHING ON YOUR MACHINE

slides.headline: PERPLEXITY DROPPED AN AI WORKER INSIDE YOUR PC
slides.body: The tool is called Personal Computer and it works like a digital employee sitting at your desk. You type what you need in plain words and it opens your files, writes documents, updates spreadsheets, and sends emails. It hit Mac in April and just expanded to Windows

slides.headline: IT WARNS YOU BEFORE TOUCHING YOUR EMAILS
slides.body: Perplexity says the AI notifies you before anything sensitive, like sending an email or deleting a file. The company promises it never trains on your data. It also plugs into Microsoft 365 and Teams, so it works across your local files and cloud apps in one place

slides.headline: $200 A MONTH PRICED OUT EVERYONE BUT YOUR BOSS
slides.body: Only Max and Enterprise Max subscribers get access, starting at $200 per month. That price means it's built for companies to give their employees, not for regular people. Perplexity calls it a 'general-purpose digital worker' built for messy everyday office tasks

slides.headline: AI ALREADY TOOK OVER THE BUSIEST DESK IN YOUR OFFICE
slides.body: Documents, emails, and spreadsheets eat most of an office day. AI tools already handle all of it without hiring anyone new. Most businesses haven't set this up yet, and the ones that move first get an edge before everyone else catches on

slides.headline: DAILY AI NEWS THAT ACTUALLY MATTERS
slides.body: Save this. Send it to someone who lives in spreadsheets all day

caption:
Perplexity just gave AI full control of your Windows PC. Swipe to see what it does and what it costs 💻

Perplexity's Personal Computer tool hits Windows, an AI that opens your files, writes documents, updates spreadsheets, sends emails, and plugs into Microsoft 365 and Teams, all controlled by plain words. Only available to paying subscribers at $200 per month, with built-in warnings before sensitive actions like sending emails or deleting files.

AI tools that control your entire desktop are here. The $200 price tag means your company decides if you get one, but the same idea already works for any business with the right setup.
